deploy-bot: Initiating canary deploy -> service=embedder version=2026.3.1 rollout=10% window=22:00-02:00 UTC
matt: starting preflight checks, grabbing SLO graphs and recent traces
rebecca: dashboard:/slo/embedder -> p50 ~48ms, p95 climbed to ~130ms (expected ~80ms). error_rate 0.32% :thinking_face:
sana: running quick kv-cache + batching smoke tests on canary nodes now
jordan: deploy-bot: observed small latency bump at 1716543255, traces point to attention-kernel on gpu-node-7 increasing compute time
matt: any config diffs in this build? quantization or scheduler changes?
rebecca: found one change: batch_timeout_ms: 5 -> 8 in scheduler config. might explain longer tails
sana: i'll fork a canary with batch_timeout_ms=5 and run perf script `./scripts/run_perf.sh --target canary --iters 50` to compare
rebecca: quick log rollup (last 10m) for service=embedder version=2026.3.1:
```
count_by(status) from logs where service="embedder" and version="2026.3.1" and ts>now()-10m
500: 12
429: 3
200: 1898
```
jordan: last 3m error rate climbed to 0.74% (alert threshold for window is 0.5%) -> proposing automated reroute: fallback-model for 2% of traffic while we investigate
matt: +1 to hold rollout at 10% and split 2% to fallback. if sustained >1% for 5m we rollback
rebecca: temporary alert rule created: embedder_deploy_error_budget_breach_temp -> paging @oncall
sana: perf runs back: p95 ~85ms with batch_timeout_ms=5, p95 ~130ms with 8. scheduler change correlates
matt: sounds like a low-risk config revert. what do we risk if we patch during rollout?
rebecca: low risk. we should tag as hotfix (config-only). need to update release notes and record the change for audit
jordan: deploy-bot: adjusted routing -> fallback split=2%, rollout paused at 10% pending manual resume by @matt
matt: applying hotfix now:
```
kubectl -n prod set env deployment/embedder BATCH_TIMEOUT_MS=5 --record
kubectl rollout restart deployment/embedder
```
rebecca: monitoring: error rate down to 0.28% after patch, p95 trending toward baseline
sana: canary fork sanity checks green. recommend resume to 25% in 10m if stable
matt: resume to 25% in 10m. watching 5m windows for error_rate>0.5% or p95>120ms -> rollback if either triggers
jordan: noted and tagging timeline for post-deploy notes: investigate scheduler defaulting behavior and why batch_timeout was changed in this revision
deploy-bot: Rollout resume scheduled -> target=25% at 1716543380. automated validation running every 1m for 15m
matt: please add short release note: "hotfix: reverted scheduler batch_timeout to 5ms to stabilize latency during rollout" and attach metric snapshots to the ops doc
rebecca: added snapshot links + short timeline: https://docs.redwood.internal/ops/embedder-deploy-1716543210
sana: will run a short retrospective tomorrow and follow up on root cause. :thumbsup:
